title: Learning Management System (LMS)
description: Scalable Learning Management System built with React, Vite, TanStack Router, TanStack Query, Zustand, and Tailwind CSS, supporting public, learner, and administrative workflows. Built and maintained course management, video learning, certificate generation, invoices, support tickets, and JWT role-based access control (RBAC).

title: Restaurant Management System (RMS/SaaS)
description: Scalable restaurant management platform built using React, Vite, and Tailwind CSS, supporting ordering, inventory, kitchen operations, reservations, billing, and reporting. Designed a modular feature-based frontend architecture with custom hooks, shared UI components, and structured API services.
highlights: Table reservations, live kitchen orders & billing
Server-state management with TanStack Query & Axios

title: Smart Hospital System
description: Full-stack healthcare platform developed using React, React Native, and Node.js. Supports emergency ambulance booking, doctor appointments, real-time bed availability, patient portal, and admin management dashboard with mapping services.
highlights: Cross-platform mobile application with real-time notifications
Mapping services integration for ambulance booking

title: Ambulance Booking System
description: Cross-platform emergency ambulance booking mobile application with real-time driver tracking, geolocation mapping services, emergency dispatch, and rapid patient onboarding.
highlights: Real-time GPS tracking of nearest ambulances

title: Omnichannel Messaging Platform
description: High-volume omnichannel customer communication platform integrating Facebook Messenger, WhatsApp, and social media channels into a unified dashboard with automated routing and agent assignment.
highlights: Unified conversational inbox for support teams

title: Vislog – Visitor Management System
description: Enterprise visitor check-in, tracking, security logging, and badge issuance platform for businesses and corporate facilities, improving safety and workplace compliance.
highlights: Digital visitor log & photo capture check-in
Exportable security records and compliance logs

title: Shopify Hair Care Store (Glarus Organics)
description: Modern e-commerce store developed for a luxury hair care brand featuring custom responsive Liquid templates, product catalog, cart drawer optimization, and technical SEO enhancements.
highlights: High Lighthouse performance & Core Web Vitals

title: Hotel Booking Tourism System
description: Full-stack tourism and hotel booking web application with room reservation management, search filtering, database operations, and responsive client interfaces.
highlights: Room search, availability checker & booking engine

title: Arduino Obstacle Detecting Robot Car
description: Autonomous obstacle-avoiding robotic vehicle engineered with Arduino microcontrollers, ultrasonic distance sensors, and DC motor drivers programmed in C++.
highlights: PWM motor speed and direction controls
